messages.content: Does Cascade support exporting project data to CSV? We need to pull our task history into our internal reporting tool.

articles.title: Exporting Projects and Tasks
articles.snippet: Cascade supports CSV and JSON export for all projects, tasks, and sub-tasks. Navigate to Project Settings → Export to download your data. Exports include task name, assignee, due date, status, and custom fields.

articles.title: API Access for Data Export
articles.snippet: For automated or bulk exports, use the Cascade REST API. The /projects/{id}/tasks endpoint returns full task history in JSON format.

output.content: Yes, Cascade supports CSV export for all projects and tasks. Go to **Project Settings → Export** to download your task history. The export includes task name, assignee, due date, status, and custom fields. If you need automated or bulk exports, you can also use the Cascade REST API (/projects/{id}/tasks). Full details are in our help article: https://help.cascade.io/articles/2041. Let me know if you have any other questions!
